name: Canal+ SA
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 from Canal+ S.A. condensed consolidated statement of earnings unaudited, six months ended 30 June 2026, 2026 half year report, unit EUR million stored in absolute euros. Revenue 4287 less printed content costs 2205 equals gross profit 2082. Operating Expenses 1716 is printed technology, selling, general, administrative costs and others 1572 plus restructuring costs 75 plus amortisation of intangible assets acquired through business combinations 69. Note that the issuer prints operating income (EBIT) of 365 while its rounded components sum to 366, a 1m rounding difference inside a 4287m revenue base. Net Finance Costs 136 is the printed net financial income loss. EBIT less Net Finance Costs is 229 and the printed earnings before income taxes is 216, the 13 difference being the printed loss from equity affiliates. 216 less income taxes 105 equals the printed earnings from continuing operations 111, which is stored as net profit; the 72 loss from discontinued operations is shown separately by the issuer and the total earnings were 39 with 29 attributable to equity holders of the parent. EPS is an honest dash: the announcement excerpt did not print a basic earnings per share figure. Source https://www.canalplusgroup.com/uploads/CANAL_2026_half_year_report_2eb5eb13e0.pdf || Yahoo Finance
